title: Studying Spanish
setting: A university library on a rainy spring day.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt)

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt)

sentences.en: On a rainy spring day, Sara and Kofi study.
sentences.zh: 在一个下雨的春日，萨拉和科菲在学习。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) sit at a desk with books, rain on the window and spring blossoms outside.

sentences.en: They sit in the library of her university.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在她所在大学的图书馆里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) at a long table in a large university library with tall bookshelves.

sentences.en: Sara learns the Spanish language at her college.
sentences.zh: 萨拉在她的学院学习西班牙语。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) reads a textbook with a small Spanish flag on its cover.

sentences.en: She must describe a photo of her home.
sentences.zh: 她得描述一张她家的照片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) holds a photo of a small white house next to her open notebook, pencil in hand.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Sara with a photo of her house and her notebook; the task of describing it can't be shown.

sentences.en: She writes a hundred words in her book.
sentences.zh: 她在本子上写了一百个词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) writes in a notebook filled with many lines of small wavy handwriting.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Sara writing many lines in her notebook; the exact number can't be shown.

sentences.en: Sara makes a mistake and feels angry.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) frowns angrily at a crossed-out line in her notebook.

sentences.en: Kofi gives her his eraser with a smile.
sentences.zh: 科菲笑着把他的橡皮递给她。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) smiles and hands a pink eraser to Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt).

sentences.en: Then he helps her with his dictionary.
sentences.zh: 然后他用他的词典帮助她。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) opens a thick dictionary and shows a page to Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt).
